# SM-06 — Data layer

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** The app stores data.
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
Transactions for related writes; indexes on foreign keys and filtered columns; a per-project pool limit; backward-compatible migrations only.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-06-L1** Related writes share a transaction; FK and filter columns are indexed; the pool limit is set. | review | `review_verdict` |
| **SM-06-L2** Each migration is backward-compatible with the previous release (expand now, contract later; M4.3). | auto | `migration_review` |

## Full
Lite, plus query-count (N+1) tests on list endpoints and concurrency tests on colliding writes.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-06-F1** List endpoints run a bounded number of queries regardless of row count. | auto | `test_report` |
| **SM-06-F2** Concurrent colliding writes on the main write path keep the data consistent (unique constraint or optimistic lock). | auto | `test_report` |

## Code signals (mid-build detector, S5)
- ORM or migrations
  - path: `(^|/)migrations?/`
  - path: `schema\.prisma$`
  - code: `@prisma/client|drizzle-orm|typeorm|sequelize|sqlalchemy|knex`
